full_text_zh:
[P1] 给孩子的山海经神话绘本
少昊之国
孟惜 编 [乌]伊娃·麦凯丽安 绘
国家开放大学出版社出版
童趣童媒(北京)文化传播有限公司出品

[P2] 给孩子的山海经神话绘本
少昊之国
孟惜 编 〔乌〕伊娃·麦凯丽安 绘
国家开放大学出版社出版
国开童媒（北京）文化传播有限公司出品
北京

[P3] 上古的时候，东海海外有一道很大很大的沟壑，
这条沟壑之下是深海中的无底之谷，名叫归墟。传说，
即使天下所有的水都注入归墟，也填不满它。
在这条沟壑周围，帝王少昊建立了他的国家。

[P4] 曾经，少昊的父母相遇在穷桑树下，
父亲抚琴，母亲和着旋律歌唱，二人由此相爱，引来凤凰飞舞……少昊出生的
那天，天空也有凤凰盘旋，它们鸣叫一
番后一齐飞落在院子里。

[P5] 后来少昊长大，建国之日，凤凰又带着百鸟来朝贺。
传说，凤凰一出现就会天下安宁。
少昊大喜，把凤凰当作族神来崇拜。并且，他也
开始喜欢和信任各种鸟儿。

[P6] 少昊决定任用鸟儿来管理国家。
凤凰美丽高贵有智慧，而且是爱好和平的吉祥神鸟，能给国家带来好运。于是，少昊让凤凰统管百鸟，各方都能信服。

[P7] 首先，少昊任命鸟儿来掌管四季。
燕子轻盈灵巧，常常是它第一个飞着宣告
春天的到来，少昊让它掌管春天。

伯劳性格刚烈、勇猛，擅长捕食苍蝇、
蚊子等害虫，少昊让它掌管夏天。

[P8] 少昊任命娇小美丽、声音高亢的鹦雀
掌管秋天。

少昊任命艳丽斑斓、勇猛好斗、不惧寒冷的锦鸡掌管冬天。

[P9] 接着，少昊任命扈鸟掌管农业。扈鸟擅长种植庄稼，它们会严格督促人们播种、施肥、收割，防止有些人整天游手好闲、无所事事。

[P10] 少昊还任命五种野鸡掌管五种手工业，分别是漆工、皮工、陶工、木工和染工。它们帮助人们发展手工业，为能工巧匠代言。

[P11] 少昊觉得教育很重要，而教育人民善良孝顺是最重要的。所以，他派以孝顺著称的鹁鸪掌管教育。

[P12] 鸷鸟凶猛威武，少昊派它掌管军事。
雄鹰威严刚正，少昊派它掌管法律。
布谷鸟处事细致稳妥，少昊派它掌管建筑。
斑鸠巧言善辩，少昊派它掌管言论。

[P13] 各种各样的鸟儿分工协作，各司其职，各展其才。
各种各样的鸟儿分工协作，各司其职，各展其才。
每到朝圣的时候，高贵优雅的凤凰带着轻盈灵巧的燕子、凶猛威武的鸷鸟、艳丽斑斓的锦鸡……一齐飞来，只听见莺歌燕语、百鸟齐鸣，好不热闹。
少昊根据鸟儿们的汇报来论功行赏和惩罚过错，大家齐心协力，把国家治理得井井有条。

[P14] 因为鸟儿们很能干，国家一片繁荣安宁，
少昊十分欣慰。他有很多的时间抚养自己的侄
儿颛顼，带着他抚琴玩耍，教他治国理政……

[P15] 颛顼从小就聪慧过人，显露出帝王的胆识。后来，少昊让颛顼接替了帝位，而他自己去了西方，成了西方的天神。这个归墟之上的国家一直四海升平，一派欣欣向荣。
full_text_en:
[P1] A Mythological Picture Book of the Classic Shan Hai Jing for Children
The Kingdom of Shao Hao
Compiled by Meng Xi, Illustrated by [Ukraine] Iva Mckaylian
Published by Open University of China Press
Produced by Tongqu Tongmei (Beijing) Cultural Communication Co., Ltd.

[P2] Mythological Picture Book from the Classic Shan Hai Jing for Children
The Kingdom of Shaohao
Compiled by Meng Xi, Illustrated by Iva McKellian (Ukraine)
Published by Open University Press
Produced by Guokai Children's Media (Beijing) Cultural Communication Co., Ltd.
Beijing

[P3] In ancient times, beyond the Eastern Sea, there was a vast and immense chasm.
Beneath this chasm lay an endless abyss in the deep sea, called Gui Xu. Legend has it,
even if all the water in the world were poured into Gui Xu, it could never fill it.
Around this chasm, Emperor Shao Hao established his kingdom.

[P4] Once, Shao Hao's parents met under the Qiong Sang tree.
His father played the qin, and his mother sang along to the melody. They fell in love, attracting phoenixes to dance around... On the day Shao Hao was born, phoenixes also circled in the sky. After calling out, they all flew down together into the courtyard.

[P5] Later, when Shao Hao grew up, on the day he founded his kingdom, the phoenix came again, leading hundreds of birds to pay homage.
Legend has it that when the phoenix appears, peace will reign throughout the world.
Shao Hao was overjoyed and revered the phoenix as the totem of his people. Moreover, he began to like and trust all kinds of birds.

[P6] Shao Hao decided to appoint birds to manage the country.
The phoenix is beautiful, noble, and wise, and is a peaceful, auspicious divine bird that brings good fortune to the nation. Thus, Shao Hao appointed the phoenix to oversee all birds, gaining the trust of all parties.

[P7] First, Shao Hao appointed birds to oversee the four seasons.
The swallow is light and nimble, often the first to fly and announce
the arrival of spring, so Shao Hao assigned it to manage spring.

The shrike is fierce and brave, skilled at catching flies,
mosquitoes, and other pests, so Shao Hao assigned it to manage summer.

[P8] Shao Hao appointed the small, beautiful, and high-voiced parrot to oversee autumn.

Shao Hao appointed the colorful, brave, and fearless pheasant to oversee winter.

[P9] Next, Shao Hao appointed the Hu bird to oversee agriculture. The Hu birds were skilled at farming and would strictly supervise people in sowing, fertilizing, and harvesting, preventing some from idling away their days doing nothing.

[P10] Shao Hao also appointed five kinds of wild chickens to oversee five crafts: lacquer work, leather work, pottery, carpentry, and dyeing. They helped people develop handicrafts and spoke on behalf of skilled artisans.

[P11] Shao Hao believed education was very important, and teaching people to be kind and filial was the most important. Therefore, he appointed the bùgū, known for its filial piety, to oversee education.

[P12] The fierce and mighty bird, the zhizhao, was appointed by Shao Hao to oversee military affairs.
The dignified and upright eagle was appointed by Shao Hao to oversee laws.
The cuckoo, known for its careful and steady nature, was appointed by Shao Hao to oversee construction.
The spotted dove, skilled in eloquence and debate, was appointed by Shao Hao to oversee public discourse.

[P13] All kinds of birds work together, each performing their own duties and showcasing their talents.
All kinds of birds work together, each performing their own duties and showcasing their talents.
During the朝圣 ceremony, the noble and elegant phoenix leads the graceful swallows, the fierce and mighty birds of prey, and the brilliantly colorful pheasants... flying together, with the sounds of birdsong and chirping filling the air, it's a lively scene.
Shao Hao rewards merits and punishes faults based on the birds' reports, and everyone works together to govern the country in an orderly manner.

[P14] Because the birds were very capable, the country was prosperous and peaceful.
Shao Hao was very pleased. He had plenty of time to raise his nephew Zhuan Xu, playing the zither with him and teaching him how to govern the country...

[P15] Zhuanyu was exceptionally wise from a young age, showing the courage and vision of a ruler. Later, Shao Hao let Zhuanyu succeed to the throne, while he himself went to the West and became the god of the Western realm. This nation above the Gui Xu has always enjoyed peace and prosperity, thriving in every aspect.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《少昊之国》的封面，展示了神话中的神鸟与古风建筑，标题和作者信息清晰可见。
[P2] 本页为绘本《少昊之国》的封面，展示了书名、作者、绘者及出版信息，配有一幅建于山巅的古风楼阁插图。
[P3] 本页描绘了上古时期东海海外的巨沟‘归墟’及其周围景象，并说明帝王少昊在此建立了国家。
[P4] 本页描绘了少昊父母在穷桑树下相遇相爱的场景，以及少昊出生时凤凰飞舞、落于院中的祥瑞景象。
[P5] 少昊建国之日，凤凰带领百鸟前来朝贺，少昊因此将凤凰奉为族神，并开始喜爱和信任各种鸟类。
[P6] 少昊决定任用鸟儿管理国家，并任命凤凰统管百鸟，因其美丽、智慧且象征和平与好运，获得各方信服。
[P7] 本页讲述了少昊任命燕子掌管春天，因其轻盈灵巧、最先宣告春来；同时任命伯劳掌管夏天，因其勇猛善捕害虫。
[P8] 少昊任命鹦雀掌管秋天，因其娇小美丽、声音高亢；同时任命锦鸡掌管冬天，因其艳丽斑斓、勇猛好斗且不惧寒冷。
[P9] 少昊任命扈鸟掌管农业，因其擅长种植庄稼，并能督促人们勤于耕作，防止懒惰。
[P10] 少昊任命五种野鸡分别掌管漆工、皮工、陶工、木工和染工，帮助人们发展手工业，并为工匠代言。
[P11] 少昊重视教育，认为培养人民的善良与孝顺最为重要，因此任命以孝顺著称的鹁鸪掌管教育事务。
[P12] 本页讲述了少昊任命鸷鸟掌管军事、雄鹰掌管法律、布谷鸟掌管建筑、斑鸠掌管言论，继续完善以鸟为官的国家管理体系。
[P13] 本页描绘了少昊以鸟为官的国家治理景象，各种鸟儿分工协作，朝圣时百鸟齐飞、热闹非凡，少昊根据鸟儿汇报论功行赏，国家井然有序。
[P14] 少昊因鸟儿们治理国家有方而感到欣慰，他有更多时间抚养和教导侄子颛顼，传授治国理政之道。
[P15] 本页讲述了少昊将帝位传给侄子颛顼，自己则前往西方成为天神，颛顼继位后国家四海升平、欣欣向荣。
[P16] 本页为一幅插图，画面中央是一个圆形构图，描绘了三只鸟在金黄色背景中飞翔的景象，其中一只大型猛禽展翅居中，两侧各有一只较小的鸟，背景有火焰般的纹路，整体呈现动态飞行的美感。
